async function run(items, read) {
 let saved = null;
 for (const item of items) {
  saved ??= await read();
 }
 for (const item of items) {
  let row = cache[item];
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
  row ??= await read(item);
 }
 for (const item of items) {
  saved = null;
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
  saved ??= await read(item);
 }
 for (const group of items) {
  let local = null;
  for (const item of group) {
   // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
   local ??= await read(item);
  }
 }
}
async function resetByAwait(items, read) {
 let saved;
 for (const item of items) {
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
  saved = await refresh(item);
  // ruleid: await-in-loop-javascript
  saved ??= await read(item);
 }
}
async function unrelatedReset(items, read) {
 let saved;
 let count = 0;
 for (const item of items) {
  count = item;
  if (saved == null) saved = await read();
 }
}
